captions.detailed: A heavy-duty pipe vise constructed with a dark gray cast-iron rectangular base block featuring a fixed V-shaped lower jaw. A secondary, rectangular upper clamp assembly is hinged at the rear of the base, allowing it to swing open or closed over a pipe. A light-gray vertical leadscrew, topped with a cylindrical T-bar handle, passes through the front of the upper clamp frame to apply downward pressure.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a pipe vise featuring a heavy rectangular cast-iron base with a fixed V-jaw, a hinged upper clamp frame attached at the rear, and a vertical leadscrew with a T-bar handle to drive the clamping mechanism.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a combination of a flat plate, rectangular blocks, and a subtracted wedge to form the lower V-jaw. Create the hinged upper clamp frame by combining parallel side plates and a front cross-bar. Model the leadscrew and its T-bar handle using cylindrical primitives, and assemble the components with a revolute joint at the rear hinge and a prismatic joint for the vertical screw movement.
